title: Content-first HR document classification and date validation
summary: The correspondence archive demonstrates that filenames can misstate both document type and date. HR ingestion should classify and date from document content/metadata first, using filenames only as weak hints.

claims.claim: A source named 'Term Doc.dotx' visibly contains an Employee Evaluation form, so filename-based document typing would misclassify it.
A staff-event memo artifact has a filename year of 2017 while the internal document text identifies the event as December 15, 2022, showing that filename dates can be stale or wrong.

evidence.note: Employee names/content are excluded; only the filename/content-date mismatch is generalized.

claims.claim: For HR scanning and ingestion, filename-derived type/date should be treated as a low-confidence hint and reconciled against visible title, internal dates, form fingerprints, document metadata, and trusted workflow context.

trigger: A document enters the HR scanner/import pipeline.
prerequisites: Content extraction or visual/form fingerprinting is available.
steps: Treat the original filename as provenance, not authoritative classification.
Detect document title/type from visible content, structural fingerprints, and metadata.
Extract internal dates and distinguish document date/effective date from filesystem or filename dates.
Compare filename hints with content-derived classification/date.
If they conflict, prefer stronger content evidence and log the mismatch for audit/review.
decisions: Whether filename/content conflicts are confidently resolvable or require manual review.
exceptions: A filename may be authoritative only where a validated workflow explicitly defines it as such.
controls: Never silently overwrite provenance; preserve the original filename outside generalized knowledge where privacy permits.
Do not use employee-identifying filenames as durable generalized knowledge.
automation_candidates: Add deterministic filename-vs-content mismatch flags to the HR GUI scanner.
Weight visible title/form fingerprints above filename tokens during classification.
Require internal-date validation before using a filename date in renamed HR documents.

provenance.notes: Derived from privacy-safe structural mismatches only.
